voidborn-citadel.webp.description: Original fantasy illustration, not an AION 2 screenshot.
voidborn-citadel.webp.prompt: Create one original cinematic dark fantasy landscape illustration for the hero background of Voidborn, a German gaming guild knowledge wiki. Ultrawide landscape 3:2 or 16:9. Ancient monumental mountain citadel on the RIGHT THIRD, soaring gothic spires, distant fractured floating stone islands, enormous pale crescent moon, layered midnight slate-blue mountain silhouettes and thin mist, a restrained warm antique gold glow in windows. Left half predominantly quiet dark navy mist, usable behind large white text. High-end painted game environment concept art, elegant atmospheric perspective, sophisticated desaturated palette, detailed realistic stone architecture, no characters in foreground. No text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Original fantasy world, do not copy any existing game's architecture. Save asset for website use.
